embeds.title: PSBL BREAKING NEWS
embeds.description: High-impact MLB news that may change a roster decision right now. Stories are posted by automation as a headline, a source name and a direct link. Full articles are never copied; open the link to read the source.

fields.name: POSTED HERE
fields.value: Season-ending or indefinite injuries • Retirements • Indefinite suspensions • Firings • Major blockbuster trades

fields.name: HOW A STORY QUALIFIES
fields.value: It must come from a trusted primary source and describe a high-impact event. Ordinary signings, depth trades and routine roster moves go to other channels.

fields.name: NOT POSTED HERE
fields.value: Rumors, opinion pieces, predictions, game threads or discussion. Talk it over in **💬│news-desk**.
